name: Home Sections - All Three Visibility States
description: The homepage band stack with one band in each visibility state, which is the only place the three can be compared directly since a real page shows one arrangement at a time. Stats renders normally, the event gallery is replaced by its coming-soon placeholder, and a drafted Support us band is absent entirely. The drafted band is passed in on purpose: the component renders nothing for it, so the three states are total here rather than depending on the page filtering first.
